title: REQ · node_modules is ignored at any depth and removed from the git index
description: Context: .gitignore has game/node_modules/ but dependencies live in game/frontend/node_modules, so they are tracked. Desired behavior: .gitignore contains a pattern matching node_modules directories at any depth and the tracked node_modules files are removed from the index with git rm --cached. Expected result: no vendored Phaser file can show as modified. Why: the intent forbids tracked node_modules changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given .gitignore, when its lines are read, then a line node_modules/ is present
Given the index after the change, when git ls-files is filtered for node_modules, then the list is empty
definition_of_done: Ignore rule present and index clean of node_modules
